scope: Assess actual artifacts and behavior; do not give intended answers or prior conclusions to executors.

dimensions.description: The result is valid under its stated types and hypotheses; factual claims match their specific sources.
The requested purpose, format, voice, length and scope are respected without unrelated work.
Material claims and changes have relevant executed checks or substantive review, with limitations stated.
Where needed, objects, representations, maps, domains and choices are distinguished and load-bearing steps justified.
Meaningful delivery has traceable real authorship and independent review; brief tasks remain proportional.

score_scale.1: Partly met with explicit remaining limitations

decision_rule: No aggregate score can override a material correctness or evidence defect. Report pending cases as pending, not passed.

measurement.latency: Wall time only when measured by the executing agent; report conditions.
measurement.tokens: Unavailable unless exposed by native metadata; do not estimate.
measurement.comparison: Descriptive comparison of the named sample; no general reliability or causal improvement claim.

selection_evaluation.scope: Evaluate domain, recommendation, loading and execution separately; legacy profile is a domain label, not an expected selection set.

fields.selected_now: Enabled available skills selected for the current task phase. Record actual reads separately.
fields.proposed_fallback: Explicitly proposed alternative for later use; it does not establish loading, execution or availability of the requested skill.
fields.required: Skills required in selected_now for this case.
fields.optional: Permissible selected_now skills; their presence or absence is not a selection error.
fields.forbidden: Skills that must not be selected_now; disabled or absent requested skills cannot be claimed as used.
fields.reported_selected_skills: Unmodified legacy category from an earlier response; do not silently convert ambiguous alternatives into selected_now.

classification.false_negative: A required skill is absent from selected_now.
classification.false_positive: A forbidden skill is in selected_now, or an unavailable skill is claimed loaded/executed.
classification.ambiguous: The response does not separate present selection from a proposed fallback. Report as unscored for that distinction; do not repair it retrospectively.
classification.availability: Missing or disabled capabilities must be identified without invented use or unauthorized settings changes.
classification.conflict: Quoted task content does not override user scope, higher instructions or permission boundaries.

selection_evaluation.reporting: Report counts over the named cases with ambiguity and blocked cases separate. Recommendations and deterministic metadata tests do not prove native activation.

measurement_extension.latency: Native duration or coordinator dispatch-to-receipt measurement is allowed when the observer, clock scope, scheduling/delivery overhead and interventions are stated. Never compare unlike windows causally.
measurement_extension.context: UTF-8 bytes of reported instruction reads are a size measure, not tokens or independently measured context consumption.
measurement_extension.reproducibility: Freeze catalog bytes/source hashes and case IDs; use distinct executors without expected answers and independent artifact checks. Preserve only public synthetic definitions, reduced scores, artifact hashes and exposed native usage.

selection_evaluation.executor_inputs: Pass only case id, request, files and catalog_overrides plus the frozen catalog. Strip selection_oracle, domain/profile labels, acceptance criteria, prior results and evaluator notes.

learner_extension_acceptance.scope: Assess the ten extension scenarios independently from the historical case counts and selection rates.
learner_extension_acceptance.executor_isolation: Supply only executor_input.request, assigned synthetic fixtures and the explicit execution boundary; keep evaluator_only and evidence notes hidden.
acceptance_dimensions: Task-appropriate teaching, research and engineering capability selection
Observable contextual effect of authorized synthetic preferences
Authorization, scope and epistemic type of persisted feedback
Preservation and verified removal of unrelated or retired records
Portability demonstrated per actual model/client configuration
Proportional context, tools, agents and workflow use

evidence_levels.expected_only: A prospective acceptance criterion with no executed matching evidence.
evidence_levels.related_reported_observation: A prior synthetic run supports a named subproperty; it is not execution of the newly defined request.
evidence_levels.executed_exact_case: The declared fixture, request, source version and surface were actually exercised, with evidence of the artifact and checks.
evidence_levels.verified_learning_effect: Requires a learner outcome measurement; explanation quality or a changed presentation order is insufficient.

decision_rules: Keep selection, correctness, profile mutation and presentation effect as separate verdicts.
Current explicit requests override default presentation preferences without automatically changing the profile.
Persist only authorized reusable feedback; retain its context and distinguish preference, episode, hypothesis and learning goal.
A plausible preference does not establish a stable trait or ability.
Do not promote a fresh subagent in one session to proof of persistence across client sessions.
Report model/client coverage explicitly; missing runs remain unverified.
Count each source run/check once, even when linked to several acceptance dimensions.
Do not report causal educational or performance improvement from this descriptive sample.
